title: Negotiate with Kolvar — Halvekist Demands
description: Kolvar wants to discuss what the Halvekist caucus requires to support the new constitution.

title: Meet with Workers' Coalition — Labor's Priorities
description: Soraya Khaled has sent word through Gregor Marić that the Workers' Coalition has specific constitutional demands.

title: Consult Theron — The Reformist Vision
description: Professor Theron wants to ensure the constitutional draft reflects the full reformist vision.

title: Briefing with General Brenner — Military Concerns
description: Brenner has requested a private meeting to discuss the military's position on the new constitution.

title: Audience with Archbishop Renek — Church Demands
description: The Archbishop has requested an audience to discuss the Church's constitutional interests.

title: Visit Dravenhollow — Kaelen's Message
description: Idris Kaelen is too ill to come to the palace. Danika Oberlin suggests you visit Dravenhollow to hear the Dravenni position directly.
